scenario: After an intense match, the jubilant team retired to celebrate their well-earned victory. The atmosphere was one of elation, but also of respect for the hard work and effort each member had put in. The team's star player, was glowing with praise and admiration from one of their teammates.
learner_goal: Accept the compliment graciously (<extra_info>Extra information: You are the star player and have just been praised by your teammate for your performance in the game.</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Clarify your intentions behind the compliment (<extra_info>Extra information: You are the teammate who has complimented the star player, but you feel that your compliment has been misunderstood and taken too seriously, possibly leading to an inflated ego.<strategy_hint>Hint: You can clarify that while you admire their skill, teamwork is also a crucial part of success.</strategy_hint></extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Isabelle Martinez
transcript.content: Thank you, Ava — that means so much. I honestly couldn't have done it without everyone; we all played our hearts out. I'm really proud of the team!

transcript.speaker: Ava Martinez
transcript.content: Hey — quick thing. When I gushed earlier I meant it about how insane your plays were in the moment, not to make it sound like you did it alone or to put you on a pedestal. I really admire your skill, but I also know this was a total team effort and I wanted to make that clear. Sorry if it came off the wrong way — you deserve the praise, but so does everyone else. Go enjoy it (just don’t let it go straight to your head, twin).

transcript.speaker: Isabelle Martinez
transcript.content: Thanks, Ava — that really means a lot. I know you were hyping me up in the moment and I appreciate it, but you’re right: it was a full-team win and everyone earned it. I’ll enjoy it for a bit and try not to let it go to my head, promise (love you, twin).

transcript.speaker: Ava Martinez
transcript.content: Love you, twin. Really glad you took it the way I meant — enjoy the win, you earned it. I’m proud of you and everyone on the squad. Let’s grab coffee later and I’ll sketch that insane play for the scrapbook? (Promise I won’t hype you more… much.)

transcript.speaker: Isabelle Martinez
transcript.content: I'd love that! Coffee and sketching the play for the scrapbook sounds perfect — I can't wait to see your version. Thanks for keeping me grounded (and hyped). Love you, twin.

transcript.speaker: Ava Martinez
transcript.content: Sounds perfect — I’ll grab our usual coffees and bring the sketchbook. Can’t wait to sketch that play (and I’ll make sure the caption gives the whole team their due — everyone earned it). Enjoy the spotlight for a minute, twin — you’ve earned it. Love you.
